description: This file provides user management functions for a backend service, including user creation, authentication, role management, and cleanup of ghost user records. It interacts with a SQLite database and includes security-related functions for password hashing and verification.

methods.name: dict _row_to_user_public(row: sqlite3.Row, roles: List[str])
methods.description: Converts a database row and roles list into a public user dict.

methods.name: Optional[sqlite3.Row] get_user_by_email(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user row from the database by email.

methods.name: Optional[sqlite3.Row] get_user_by_public_id(conn: sqlite3.Connection, public_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user row based on their public ID.

methods.name: List[str] get_user_roles(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches the list of roles assigned to a user.

methods.name: int ensure_role_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection, role_name: str)
methods.description: Ensures a role exists in the database, creating it if necessary, handling race conditions.

methods.name: None assign_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int, role_name: str)
methods.description: Assigns a role to a user, creating the role if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: dict create_user( conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str, username: Optional[str], full_name: Optional[str], role_name: str, )
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified details, hashes passwords, assigns roles, and returns user info.

methods.name: Optional[dict] authenticate_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and returns user info if authentication succeeds.

methods.name: int cleanup_ghost_user_records_for_email(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str)
methods.description: Removes ghost or incomplete user records based on specific criteria, ensuring referential integrity.

ctags.name: assign_role
ctags.pattern: /^def assign_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int, role_name: str) -> None:$/

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^def authenticate_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> Optional[dict]:$/

ctags.name: create_user
ctags.signature: ( conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str, username: Optional[str], full_name: Optional[str], role_name: str, )
